title: backlog.py check stays silent when a code task's docs sit in a sibling, an earlier task or its parent
goal: docs_warnings warns whenever a doc kb/_self/map.csv maps to an item's code is outside that item's own scope (its touches and its descendants'), not only when no item holds it or only later tasks do: a docs task the code task depends on, a sibling or the parent story holding the doc is a warning, since the code commit cannot carry the doc lines; test_check_warns_docs_in_later_task no longer asserts warnings=0 for a doc held by an item that does not depend on the code task (SP-ar52y6fk review of ST-rkirzt76)

run: import sys,json,shutil,tempfile,pathlib as P;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import backlog as B;r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());d=r/'kb/_self/backlog';d.mkdir(parents=True);shutil.copy('kb/_self/map.csv',r/'kb/_self/map.csv');w=lambda i:(d/(i['id']+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(i));w(dict(id='TK-aaaaaaaa',kind='task',title='Code',status='todo',touches=['_tools/backlog.py'],depends_on=['TK-dddddddd']));w(dict(id='TK-dddddddd',kind='task',title='Docs',status='todo',touches=['kb/_self/tools.md','kb/_self/backlog.md']));out=B.docs_warnings(B.Backlog(r));assert out,'no warning: the code task depends on the task holding its docs'
